channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: Woman charged with burglarizing two New York synagogues days apart
item.description: 33-year-old woman arrested after police link her to burglaries at two synagogues in Monticello just days apart.

item.title: Sharren Haskel vows to stay in race despite polls: We will cross the electoral threshold
item.description: "Israel First" chairwoman Sharren Haskel tells Arutz Sheva-Israel National News she will not drop out of the race: "We will cross the electoral threshold."

item.title: US Energy Secretary: Iran nuclear deal may not be reached
item.description: US Energy Secretary Chris Wright says in TV interviews that Washington may prevent Iran from obtaining nuclear weapons by destroying its capabilities rather than reaching a deal.

item.description: AfD scores landslide victory in key German state

item.title: Religious Zionist Party’s central committee approves: Smotrich to pursue further alliances
item.description: The Religious Zionist Party’s central committee approves the technical bloc with Zehut and authorizes Smotrich to pursue additional alliances. The minister directly appeals to Ofer Winter.

item.title: Watch: Nova survivors and freed hostages dance at Auschwitz
item.description: Watch: Nova survivors and freed hostages dance at Auschwitz

item.title: Lebanese reports: One killed, two injured in strike on vehicle in Nabatieh
item.description:
Lebanese media outlets reported that the IDF struck a vehicle in the Nabatieh area of southern Lebanon.
According to the reports, one person was killed and two others were injured in the strike.

item.title: PA report: Man killed in clashes with Israelis east of Qalqilya
item.description:
Palestinian Arabs reported clashes with Israelis in the village of Hajjah, east of Qalqilya. According to their claims, a drone operating over the village was brought down after Palestinian Arabs threw rocks at it. The Israelis then arrived in the village to retrieve the drone, leading to clashes at the scene.
According to the reports, an Israeli military force that arrived at the scene opened fire at Palestinian Arabs who were throwing stones at the soldiers. The Palestinian Arabs reported that one person was killed in the incident.

item.title: Iran to establish 'prohibited zone' near Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran says it will establish a “prohibited zone" near the Strait of Hormuz as petrol prices rise and US economic and military pressure intensifies.

item.title: Man moderately injured after car hits electric scooter in Ashdod
item.description:
A man in his 40s was moderately injured after being hit by a car while riding an electric scooter in Ashdod.
Magen David Adom (MDA) teams provided him with medical treatment and evacuated him to Sheba Hospital at Tel Hashomer.

item.title: At least five killed after Amazon cargo plane overruns runway at Miami airport
item.description: At least five people were killed Sunday afternoon when an Amazon cargo aircraft overran the runway while landing at Miami International Airport and struck multiple vehicles on a road surrounding the airport, officials said.

item.title: Arab reports of injuries in IDF strikes in central and northern Gaza
item.description: Arab media outlets reported that several people were injured in IDF strikes in central and northern Gaza.

item.title: Good news for drivers: Gas prices plunge
item.description: Order signed by Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich to reduce the fuel excise tax takes effect at midnight. As a result, the price of a liter of gasoline falls from 8.25 shekels to 7.75 shekels.

item.title: Why is the Democratic Party condoning Antisemitism
item.description: How can the Democrat Party be so blatantly ant-Israel? Opinion.

item.title: 10-year-old girl seriously injured in accident on Highway 99 near Snir
item.description:
Five people were injured in a collision between two vehicles on Highway 99 near Snir. A 10-year-old girl sustained serious injuries, including abdominal trauma. A 19-year-old man was moderately injured, while three others sustained minor injuries.
Magen David Adom (MDA) teams evacuated the injured to Rambam and Ziv hospitals.

item.title: Brain-eating amoeba confirmed in 9-year-old after Kinneret swim
item.description: The Health Ministry has issued new Kinneret bathing recommendations after a 9-year-old was hospitalized in severe condition with a rare amoeba infection.

item.title: Lebanese reports: Hezbollah affiliated journalist wounded in IDF strike
item.description: Lebanese media reported that Ali Shabib, a correspondent for the Hezbollah-affiliated Al-Manar network, was wounded in an IDF strike in Nabatieh, southern Lebanon.

item.title: Ayelet Shaked drops election bid, eyes Likud comeback
item.description: Former minister Ayelet Shaked says she will not run in the upcoming elections, but is expected to join Likud.

item.title: Watch: Black smoke over Miami after Amazon cargo plane overshoots runway
item.description: Amazon Prime Air Boeing 767 overruns runway at Miami International Airport, with flames and thick smoke visible as authorities shut all runways.

item.title: The union that could skyrocket Winter, Smotrich and Feiglin
item.description: איחוד אפשרי בימין עשוי לשנות משמעותית את מפת המנדטים: לפי סקר כאן חדשות, רשימה משותפת של וינטר, סמוטריץ' ופייגלין זוכה ל-11 מנדטים. ללא וינטר, החיבור בין הציונות הדתית לזהות עומד על 6 מנדטים.

item.title: Yisrael Beytenu unveils election slate as key figures exit
item.description: Lieberman’s party reveals its candidates for the 26th Knesset, while some prominent figures resign and others are left off the slate.

item.title: Royal visit: South African Queen and Princes get inside look at MDA
item.description: South African Queen, Princes and Princesses tour MDA’s advanced facilities in Israel, with one royal calling the experience ‘life-changing.’

item.title: Not standard issue: IDF soldier’s ‘serial killer’ patch lands him in trouble
item.description: Armed IDF soldier filmed at Tel Aviv train station wearing ‘Serial Killer’ and other unusual patches; IDF says he will face disciplinary proceedings.

item.title: Fake abduction report triggers major police, IDF response
item.description: A late-night call claiming three Israelis were being abducted sent police and IDF forces rushing to Hizma-only for investigators to allege the group had entered the village voluntarily and falsely reported an abduction.

item.title: IDF planning on operating in Lebanon in coming hours, explosions expected in northern Israel
item.description:
The Kiryat Shmona Municipality announced that IDF forces are expected to operate in Lebanon within the next hour, and that explosions may be heard in Kiryat Shmona and communities across the Galilee.
At this stage, normal routines remain in place and no special instructions have been issued to the public.

item.title: Jerusalem mugger pulls knife at ATM, victim pulls gun
item.description: Knife-wielding suspect allegedly attacks civilian withdrawing cash at Jerusalem ATM; intended victim draws his pistol and shoots, severely wounding him.
